FORM.TITLE: Register company
FORM.SUBTITLE: Create the client company and send its access key to the administrative email.
FORM.NAME: Legal name
FORM.NAME_HINT: It becomes fixed: the client will see it locked in the onboarding.
FORM.DEDICATED_HINT: Only if the client's own policy requires its data in a separate database. Otherwise its data is isolated in the shared database.
FORM.DEDICATED_WARNING: This decision can't be reverted without migrating the data. Dedicated databases are not available yet: for now registration only supports the shared database.
FORM.MAX_USERS_HINT: How many people the company can have in Monkey. Active, pending and suspended accounts of any role count; deactivated ones don't. It can be changed later.
FORM.MAX_USERS_INVALID: Enter a whole number from 1 up.
FORM.INCOMPLETE_MESSAGE: Fill in the required fields before continuing.
FORM.ERROR_TITLE: The company could not be registered
FORM.FRAMEWORKS_HINT: The frameworks contracted for this company. Only SOC 2 is available today; the others are shown as offers and will be enabled once built. When declaring a service, the client will see all of them but can only pick the ones contracted.
FORM.FRAMEWORKS_ERROR: The available frameworks could not be loaded.

KEY.TITLE: Access key sent
KEY.SENT: We sent the access key for {{name}} to {{email}}.
KEY.FAILED_BODY: {{name}} was registered, but we could not send the key to {{email}}. Resend a new key; the previous one is revoked.
KEY.RESEND_SUCCESS_MESSAGE: We sent a new key to {{email}}. The previous one stopped working.
KEY.RESEND_ERROR_TITLE: The key could not be resent
KEY.RESEND_FAILED_MESSAGE: We could not send the key to {{email}}. The new key already exists: press “Resend key” again.

ARCHIVE.TITLE: Archive company
ARCHIVE.SUBTITLE: Cuts access now and deletes everything when the period ends.
ARCHIVE.CONSEQ_ACCESS: All its users lose access and their sessions are closed.
ARCHIVE.CONSEQ_ENGINES: Automatic evaluations stop and no new data is received.
ARCHIVE.CONSEQ_KEPT: Its data and users are kept, without access, until the deletion date; an encrypted copy is also saved.
ARCHIVE.CONSEQ_DELETE: On {{date}} everything is deleted, including the audit trail and that copy. It cannot be recovered.
ARCHIVE.CONSEQ_REVERSIBLE: Until then you can reactivate it.

REASON.client_request: The client no longer wants the service

ARCHIVE.RETENTION_HINT: It will be deleted on {{date}}. Default 180 days (6 months); minimum {{min}}.
ARCHIVE.CONFIRM_LABEL: Type the legal name to confirm:
ARCHIVE.CONFIRM_MISMATCH: The legal name does not match.

QUOTA.TITLE: Change user quota
QUOTA.SUBTITLE: How many people the company can have in Monkey.
QUOTA.LABEL: Contracted users
QUOTA.HINT: Active, pending and suspended accounts of any role count; deactivated ones don't. It can't be lower than the accounts already counted.
QUOTA.BELOW_CURRENT: It must be at least {{min}}: that many accounts already count. Deactivate some first if you need fewer.
QUOTA.BELOW_CURRENT_SERVER: The quota can't be lower than the {{count}} accounts already counted. Deactivate some first.
QUOTA.SUCCESS_MESSAGE: {{name}} now has a quota of {{max}} users.
QUOTA.ERROR_TITLE: The quota could not be changed

REACTIVATE.TITLE: Reactivate company
REACTIVATE.SUBTITLE: Gives its users access back and cancels the deletion.
REACTIVATE.INFO: {{name}} would be deleted on {{date}}. When reactivated, the period disappears and its users must sign in again.
